# ENS Design System

Source: https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/blob/main/README.md

# ENS Design System

A design system for ENS built with React and vanilla-extract.

**NOTE: This project is in alpha stage. It is in active development and is subject to change.**

## Install

```bash
pnpm i react react-dom @ensdomains/thorin@next
```

## Documentation

You can find the full documentation on the [project website](https://thorin.ens.domains).

The documentation is divided into two sections.

- `Guides` : Documentation and tips for working on this project.
- `Components` : Documentation and sample code for each individual component.

## Development

```bash
gh clone repo @ensdomains/thorin
pnpm i
pnpm dev
```

Before development, it is recommended that you read the following:

- [Development Guide](https://thorin.ens.domains/guides/development) - Information and tips to help you when working on this project including:
- [Component Groups](https://thorin.ens.domains/guides/development#component-groups) - How the components are organized.
- [Adding Components](https://thorin.ens.domains/guides/development#adding-components) - A list of files that need to be added or modified for each component.
- [Style Guidlines](https://thorin.ens.domains/guides/development#style-guidelines) - Rules and tips to follow to keep the project code consistent and maintainable.
- [Common Issues](https://thorin.ens.domains/guides/development#common-issues) - A list of known issues and how to resolve them.

## Contributing

Contribute to this project by sending a pull request.

## Sources

Forked from [degen](https://github.com/mirror-xyz/degen).

# development.mdx

Source: https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/blob/main/docs/src/guides/development.mdx

title: Development
description: Guidelines for working on thorin

## Set Up

Clone repository, install dependencies, and run the dev script to start the docs.

```bash
gh repo clone @ensdomains/thorin
cd thorin
pnpm i
```

## Component Groups

Components are organized in folders according to the [`Atomic Design Methodology`](https://atomicdesign.bradfrost.com/chapter-2/).

**Atoms** serve as the foundational building blocks that comprise all our user interfaces. These atoms include basic HTML elements like form labels, inputs, buttons, and others that can’t be broken down any further without ceasing to be functional.

**Molecules** are relatively simple groups of UI elements functioning together as a unit. For example, a form label, search input, and button can join together to create a search form molecule.

**Organisms** are relatively complex UI components composed of groups of molecules and/or atoms and/or other organisms. These organisms form distinct sections of an interface.

## Adding Components

Adding a component requires adding and modifying several files. The different steps to adding a component are:

### 1. Create a component file

The react component should be named using [`pascal case`](https://techterms.com/definition/pascalcase) convention (e.g. PascalCase). The react component file should use the component name with a **.tsx** file extension. It should be added to a folder named as the component name and nested in the [`Component Group`](#component-groups) folder at _components/src/components_.

### 2. Create a component test file

The react component test file should have the same name as the component a **.test.tsx** file extension. It should be located in the same directory as the component file.

### 3. Create a component index file

The react component and type should be exported in an index file in the same directory as the component file. If a generic Props type was used, export it using an alias.

```tsx
export { ComponentName } from './ComponentName'
export type { Props as ComponentNameProps } from './ComponentName'
```

### 4. Add the component to the exports in the Component Group index file

The react component should be added to the list of exports in the index file located in the [`Component Group`](#component-groups) folder in _components/src/components_. Only the react component needs to be exported.

### 5. Create a mdx file

The component mdx file should have the same name as the react component with a **.docs.mdx** file extension. It should be added to the [`Component Group`](#component-groups) folder in _docs/src/reference/mdx_.

### 6. Create a snippets file

The component snippets file should have the same name as the react component with a **.snippets.tsx** file extension. It should be added to the [`Component Group`](#component-groups) folder in _docs/src/reference/snippets_.

### 7. Add the component to the module export test

Add the component to the module export test located at _components/src/index.test.tsx_.

## Style Guidelines

### Components

Use **functional components** with hooks and **avoid using inline styles**.

**Add displayName** to component. This is neccessary for playroom to generate snippets from code.

```tsx
const Component = () => <div />

Component.displayName = 'Component'
```

### Snippets

Playroom uses [react-element-to-jsx-string](https://www.npmjs.com/package/react-element-to-jsx-string) to convert a react component into a string which can be used by playroom. In certain situations it is not able to accurately convert the element, such as if the components' children includes a function.

If you are having problems with your snippet in playroom, convert your snippet code to a single line string. **Do not use backslash** to break the string into multiple lines.

```tsx
export const snippets: Snippet[] = [
  {
    name: 'Basic',
    code: '<FileInput>{(context) => context.name ? <div>{context.name}</div> : <div>Attach a file</div>}</FileInput>',
  },
]
```

### Docs

When you need to import a component within the _docs/_ folder, **link to components from @ensdomains/thorin**.

```
import { Field } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
```

For updates to components to appear in files in the _docs/_ folder, you will first need to **build the components** using:

```bash
pnpm build:components
```

## Test

```bash
pnpm test
```

## Build

To build the comopnents in the components library use:

```bash
pnpm build:components
```

To build the entire project use:

```bash
pnpm build
```

## Publishing New Versions

[Create a new release](https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/releases/new) on GitHub with a tag that follows [semantic versioning](https://semver.org/). Publishing a release triggers a workflow for building, testing, and pushing to [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ensdomains/thorin).

## Common Issues

### My component did not update in my mdx file?

Update the component using `pnpm build:component` and reload the page after the script has completed.

### My snippet looks malformed

Check if displayName has been added to component. If not, then you may need to conver the snippet to a string. See the [snippets section](#snippets) for more details.

### Playroom is giving an error that a component or module is not available

Check if the module or component has been exported in _docs/src/playroom/components.ts_.

### Code preview in mdx file is giving an error that a component or module is not available

Check that the component or module is included in the scope property of the LiveProvider component in _docs/src/components/CodePreview/CodePreview.tsx_.

### The value in the Type column in the documentation props table is oddly formatted.

You can customize the format of the type value by adding conditions to the function **formatPropType** in _docs/src/components/PropsTable.tsx_.

# index.mdx

Source: https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/blob/main/docs/src/reference/index.mdx

## Install

```sh
pnpm i react react-dom @ensdomains/thorin@next
```

## Set Up

Wrap the root of your app in a ThemeProvider. Import **ThorinGlobalStyles** and declare it as a child of **ThemeProvider**. Import **lightTheme** or **darkTheme** and pass it to the **ThemeProvider**. Add [Satoshi](https://www.fontshare.com/fonts/satoshi) to your font stack.

In this example we are adding the **lightTheme**.

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react'
import { ThemeProvider } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
import '@ensdomains/thorin/dist/thorin.css'

const App = () => {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider theme={lightTheme}>
      {children}
    </ThemeProvider>
  )
}
```

### Dark Theme

To use the dark theme, import `darkTheme` and pass it to the `ThemeProvider`.

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react'
import { ThemeProvider, darkTheme } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
import '@ensdomains/thorin/dist/thorin.css'

const App = () => {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider theme={darkTheme}>
      {children}
    </ThemeProvider>
  )
}
```

### Custom Themes

To customise the theme, you can change properties on either the `lightTheme` or `darkTheme` objects, or create an entirely new one.

```tsx
import { ThemeProvider, lightTheme } from '@ensdomains/thorin'

const theme = {
  ...lightTheme,
  colors: {
    ...lightTheme.colors,
    foreground: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)',
  },
}

const App = () => {
  return <ThemeProvider theme={theme}>{children}</ThemeProvider>
}
```

## Use Components

```tsx
import { Button, LockSVG } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
```

```tsx live=true expand=true
<Box alignItems="center" gap="4">
  <div style={{ width: '180px' }}>
    <Button prefix={LockSVG} variant="primary">
      Connect Wallet
    </Button>
  </div>
</Box>
```

## Component Groups

Thorin is organized according to the [`Atomic Design Methodology`](https://atomicdesign.bradfrost.com/chapter-2/).

**Atoms** serve as the foundational building blocks that comprise all our user interfaces. These atoms include basic HTML elements like form labels, inputs, buttons, and others that can’t be broken down any further without ceasing to be functional.

**Molecules** are relatively simple groups of UI elements functioning together as a unit. For example, a form label, search input, and button can join together to create a search form molecule.

**Organisms** are relatively complex UI components composed of groups of molecules and/or atoms and/or other organisms. These organisms form distinct sections of an interface.

# Avatar.docs.mdx

Source: https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/blob/main/docs/src/reference/mdx/atoms/Avatar.docs.mdx

title: Avatar
description: An image that represents an entity

```tsx
import { Avatar } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
```

```tsx live=true expand=true
<div style={{ maxWidth: '50px' }}>
  <Avatar label="Noun 97" src={avatars.noun97} />
</div>
```

## Props

## Sizes

The size of the avatar is controlled by the width of it's parent component.

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" alignItems="center" flexDirection="row" flexWrap="wrap" gap="4">
  <div style={{ width: '100px' }}>
    <Avatar label="Noun 97" src={avatars.noun97} />
  </div>
  <div style={{ width: '75px' }}>
    <Avatar label="Noun 97" src={avatars.noun97} />
  </div>
  <div style={{ width: '50px' }}>
    <Avatar label="Noun 97" src={avatars.noun97} />
  </div>
  <div style={{ width: '25px' }}>
    <Avatar label="Noun 97" src={avatars.noun97} />
  </div>
</Box>
```

## Placeholder

The placeholder is shown if the src property is undefined or if an error occurs loading the src.

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" alignItems="center" flexDirection="row" flexWrap="wrap" gap="4">
  <Box display="flex" alignItems="center" gap="4"> 
    <Typography variant="label">undefined src</Typography>
    <div style={{ width: '100px' }}>
      <Avatar />
    </div>
  </Box>
  <Box display="flex" alignItems="center" gap="4">  
    <Typography variant="label">broken Link</Typography>
    <div style={{ width: '100px' }}>
      <Avatar src="http://thisisa.com/brockenLink.jpg" />
    </div>
  </Box>
</Box>
```

## Shapes

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" alignItems="center" flexDirection="row" flexWrap="wrap" gap="4">
  <div style={{ width: '100px' }}>
    <Avatar label="Noun 97 circle" shape="circle" src={avatars.noun97} />
  </div>
  <div style={{ width: '100px' }}>
    <Avatar label="Noun 97 square" shape="square" src={avatars.noun97} />
  </div>
</Box>
```

## Overlay

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" alignItems="center" flexDirection="row" flexWrap="wrap" gap="4">
  <Avatar
    label="Noun 97"
    src={avatars.noun97}
    size="10"
  />
  <Avatar
    label="Noun 97"
    checked
    src={avatars.noun97}
    size="10"
  />
  <Avatar
    label="Noun 97"
    src={avatars.noun97}
    disabled
    size="10"
  />
  <Avatar
    label="Noun 97"
    icon={CrossSVG}
    src={avatars.noun97}
    size="10"
  />
  <Avatar
    label="Noun 97"
    icon={PersonSVG}
    src={avatars.noun97}
    size="10"
  />
</Box>
```

## Disabled

The placeholder is shown if the src property is undefined or if an error occurs loading the src.

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex"  alignItems="center" flexDirection="row" flexWrap="wrap" gap="4">
  <Typography variant="label">Placeholder</Typography>
  <div style={{ width: '100px' }}>
    <Avatar disabled />
  </div>
  <Typography variant="label">Avatar</Typography>
  <div style={{ width: '100px' }}>
    <Avatar disabled src={avatars.noun97} />
  </div>
</Box>
```

## next/image

If you are using Next.js and configured [`next/image`](https://nextjs.org/docs/api-reference/next/image) appropriately, you can pass it in with the `as` prop.

```tsx live=true expand=true
<div style={{width: "50px"}}>
<Avatar as={NextImage} label="Noun 97" src={avatars.noun97} />
</div>
```

# Button.docs.mdx

Source: https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/blob/main/docs/src/reference/mdx/atoms/Button.docs.mdx

title: Button
description: An element that can trigger an action

```tsx
import { Button } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
```

```tsx expand=true live=true
<Button>Connect Wallet</Button>
```

## Props

## States

```tsx live=true expand=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="row" flexWrap="wrap" gap="4">
  <Button loading width="fit">Loading</Button>
  <Button disabled width="fit">Disabled</Button>
  <Button
    disabled={getState('loading')}
    loading={getState('loading')}
    onClick={() => {
      toggleState('loading')
      setTimeout(() => toggleState('loading'), 1000)
    }}
    width="fit"
  >
    Click Me
  </Button>
</Box>
```

## Sizes

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" alignItems="center" flexDirection="row" flexWrap="wrap" gap="4">
  <Button size="medium" width="fit">Connect Wallet</Button>
  <Button size="small" width="fit">Connect Wallet</Button>
</Box>
```

## Color Style

### States

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Button colorStyle="transparent">Transparent</Button>
  <Button colorStyle="background">Background</Button>
</Box>
```

### Primary

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" flexWrap="wrap" gap="4">
  <Button colorStyle="accentPrimary">Accent</Button>
  <Button colorStyle="bluePrimary">Blue</Button>
  <Button colorStyle="indigoPrimary">Indigo</Button>
  <Button colorStyle="purplePrimary">Purple</Button>
  <Button colorStyle="pinkPrimary">Pink</Button>
  <Button colorStyle="redPrimary">Red</Button>
  <Button colorStyle="orangePrimary">Orange</Button>
  <Button colorStyle="yellowPrimary">Yellow</Button>
  <Button colorStyle="greenPrimary">Green</Button>
  <Button colorStyle="greyPrimary">Grey</Button>
</Box>
```

### Secondary

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Button colorStyle="accentSecondary">Accent</Button>
  <Button colorStyle="blueSecondary">Blue</Button>
  <Button colorStyle="indigoSecondary">Indigo</Button>
  <Button colorStyle="purpleSecondary">Purple</Button>
  <Button colorStyle="pinkSecondary">Pink</Button>
  <Button colorStyle="redSecondary">Red</Button>
  <Button colorStyle="orangeSecondary">Orange</Button>
  <Button colorStyle="yellowSecondary">Yellow</Button>
  <Button colorStyle="greenSecondary">Green</Button>
  <Button colorStyle="greySecondary">Grey</Button>
</Box>
```

## Loading

The loading icon will replace either the prefix or suffix in that order. If no prefix or suffix is set it will inject itself into the prefix

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Button loading={getState('loading')} prefix={PlusSVG}>
    With Prefix
  </Button>
  <Button loading={getState('loading')} suffix={PlusSVG}>
    With Suffix
  </Button>
  <Button loading={getState('loading')}>No Prefix or Suffix</Button>
  <Button onClick={() => toggleState('loading')}>Toggle Loading</Button>
</Box>
```

## Count

```tsx live=true
<Box gap="4" display="flex" flexDirection="column">
  <Button center count={3} prefix={PlusSVG}>
    Add Entry
  </Button>
  <Button center count={3} suffix={PlusSVG}>
    Add Entry
  </Button>
  <Button center count={300} prefix={PlusSVG} suffix={PlusSVG}>
    Add Entry
  </Button>
</Box>
```

## Shapes

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="row" flexWrap="wrap" gap="4">
  <Button loading={getState('loading')} shape="square">
    Square
  </Button>
  <Button loading={getState('loading')} shape="circle">
    Circle
  </Button>
  <Button loading={getState('loading')} shape="rounded" width="fit">
    Rounded
  </Button>
  <Button onClick={() => toggleState('loading')}>Toggle Loading</Button>
</Box>
```

## Link

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="row" flexWrap="wrap" gap="4" gap="4">
  <Button as="a" href="https://ens.domains" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank" width="fit">
    Visit ENS
  </Button>
  <NextLink href="/" passHref>
    <Button as="a" width="fit">Go to Home</Button>
  </NextLink>
</Box>
```

## Width

```tsx live=true
<Button shape="rounded" width="45">
  Connect
</Button>
```

# DynamicPopover.docs.mdx

Source: https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/blob/main/docs/src/reference/mdx/atoms/DynamicPopover.docs.mdx

title: DynamicPopover
description: Abstracts the positioning of popover elements so that they are visible on the screen. You probably want to use Tooltip instead of using this directly.

```tsx
import { Button, DynamicPopover } from '@ensdomains/thorin'

const Tooltip = ({
  content,
  placement,
  mobilePlacement,
  ...props
}: TooltipProps) => {
  const tooltipRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const popover = (
    <TooltipPopover
      $mobilePlacement={mobilePlacement}
      $placement={placement}
      ref={tooltipRef}
    >
      {content}
    </TooltipPopover>
  )
  return DynamicPopover({
    popover,
    tooltipRef,
    placement,
    mobilePlacement,
    ...props,
  })
}
```

## Props

---

# Field.docs.mdx

Source: https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/blob/main/docs/src/reference/mdx/atoms/Field.docs.mdx

title: Field
description: Wrapper for form content that adds labels and status messages

```tsx
import { Field } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
```

```tsx live=true expand=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Field description="Description" label="Label" labelSecondary="Secondary">
    <div style={{ backgroundColor: 'black', height: 20 }} />
  </Field>
  <Field
    description="Description"
    inline
    label="Label"
    labelSecondary="Secondary"
  >
    <div style={{ backgroundColor: 'black', width: 20, height: 20 }} />
  </Field>
</Box>
```

## Props

## Variants

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Field description="Description" label="Default Field">
    <div style={{ backgroundColor: 'black', height: 20 }} />
  </Field>
  <Field description="Description" inline label="Inline Field">
    <div style={{ backgroundColor: 'black', height: 20, width: 20 }} />
  </Field>
  <Field description="Description" inline label="Reverse Inline Field" reverse>
    <div style={{ backgroundColor: 'black', height: 20, width: 20 }} />
  </Field>
</Box>
```

## Required

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Field description="Description or help text" label="Label" required>
    <div style={{ backgroundColor: 'black', height: 20 }} />
  </Field>
  <Field description="Description or help text" inline label="Label" required>
    <div style={{ backgroundColor: 'black', height: 20, width: 20 }} />
  </Field>
</Box>
```

## Description

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Field description="Description or help text" label="Label">
    <div style={{ backgroundColor: 'black', height: 20 }} />
  </Field>
  <Field description="Description or help text" inline label="Label">
    <div style={{ backgroundColor: 'black', height: 20, width: 20 }} />
  </Field>
</Box>
```

## Error

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Field error="Error message" label="Label">
    <div style={{ backgroundColor: 'black', height: 20 }} />
  </Field>
  <Field error="Error message" inline label="Label">
    <div style={{ backgroundColor: 'black', height: 20, width: 20 }} />
  </Field>
</Box>
```

## Disabled

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Field description="Description message" disabled label="Label">
    <div style={{ backgroundColor: 'black', height: 20 }} />
  </Field>
  <Field description="Description message" disabled inline label="Label">
    <div style={{ backgroundColor: 'black', height: 20, width: 20 }} />
  </Field>
</Box>
```

## Hide Label

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Field hideLabel label="Label">
    <div style={{ backgroundColor: 'black', height: 20 }} />
  </Field>
  <Field hideLabel inline label="Label">
    <div style={{ backgroundColor: 'black', height: 20, width: 20 }} />
  </Field>
</Box>
```

## Consume ID

The content wrapped by field sets an `id` automatically for accessibility. You can customize the behavior by using the render prop.

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Field label="Automatically injected">
    <div style={{ backgroundColor: 'black', height: 20 }} />
  </Field>

  <Field label="Render prop">
    {(ids) => (
      <div style={{ backgroundColor: 'black', height: 20 }} {...ids.content} />
    )}
  </Field>
</Box>
```

---

# FileInput.docs.mdx

Source: https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/blob/main/docs/src/reference/mdx/atoms/FileInput.docs.mdx

title: FileInput
description: A HOC used to build components for accepting files.

```tsx
import { FileInput } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
```

```tsx live=true expand=true
<FileInput maxSize={1} onChange={(file) => alert(file)}>
  {(context) =>
    context.name ? (
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        {context.name}
        <div style={{ width: '48px' }}>
          <Button
            shape="circle"
            size="small"
            variant="secondary"
            onClick={context.reset}
          >
            <VisuallyHidden>Remove</VisuallyHidden>
            <CloseSVG />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    ) : (
      <div>{context.droppable ? 'Drop file' : 'Attach file'}</div>
    )
  }
</FileInput>
```

## Props

## Context Props

<PropsTable
  types={{
    droppable: {
      name: 'droppable',
      description:
        'If true, a file has been dragged inside the component. Used to make UI updates.',
      type: {
        raw: 'boolean',
      },
    },
    file: {
      name: 'file',
      description: 'The file that is ready to be accepted.',
      type: {
        raw: 'File',
      },
    },
    focused: {
      name: 'focused',
      description: 'If true the component is focused. Used to make UI updates.',
      type: {
        raw: 'boolean',
      },
    },
    name: {
      name: 'name',
      description: 'The name of the file.',
      type: {
        raw: 'string',
      },
    },
    type: {
      name: 'type',
      description: 'The file type of the file',
      type: {
        raw: 'string',
      },
    },
    reset: {
      name: 'reset',
      description: 'An event handler used to reset input component.',
      type: {
        raw: 'MouseEvent<HTMLInputElement>',
      },
    },
  }}
/>

## Error Handling

The error value should be stored in the parent component and use the `error` and `onError` properties to synchronize state. To display an error message, wrap the component in a `Field` component. A truthy value for `error` will add `aria-invalid` to the input for accessibility.

```tsx live=true
<Field error="An error has occurred">
  <FileInput
    error
    maxSize={0.01}
    onChange={(file) => alert(file)}
    onError={(error) => alert(error)}
  >
    {(context) =>
      context.name ? (
        <div>
          {context.name}
          <Button
            shape="circle"
            size="small"
            variant="transparent"
            onClick={context.reset}
          >
            <VisuallyHidden>Remove</VisuallyHidden>
            <IconClose />
          </Button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div>{context.droppable ? 'Drop file' : 'Attach file (max 10kb)'}</div>
      )
    }
  </FileInput>
</Field>
```

## Max Size

```tsx live=true
<FileInput
  maxSize={0.01}
  onChange={(file) => alert(file)}
  onError={(error) => alert(error)}
>
  {(context) =>
    context.name ? (
      <div>
        {context.name}
        <Button
          shape="circle"
          size="small"
          variant="transparent"
          onClick={context.reset}
        >
          <VisuallyHidden>Remove</VisuallyHidden>
          <IconClose />
        </Button>
      </div>
    ) : (
      <div>{context.droppable ? 'Drop file' : 'Attach file (max 10kb)'}</div>
    )
  }
</FileInput>
```

# Heading.docs.mdx

Source: https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/blob/main/docs/src/reference/mdx/atoms/Heading.docs.mdx

title: Heading
description: Page and section title

```tsx
import { Heading } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
```

```tsx expand=true live=true
<Heading>Hello World</Heading>
```

## Props

## Levels

By default, the semantic heading level matches the visual heading level, e.g. `<Heading level="2">` will render an `h2` element. If you need the semantics to be different from the visuals, you can provide the desired HTML tag via the `as` prop.

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Heading level="1">Level 1</Heading>
  <Heading level="2">Level 2</Heading>
  <Heading as="h3" level="2">
    Level 2 as h3
  </Heading>
</Box>
```

## Align

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Heading align="left">Left</Heading>
  <Heading align="center">Center</Heading>
  <Heading align="right">Right</Heading>
</Box>
```

## Color

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Heading color="text">Text</Heading>
  <Heading color="textSecondary">Text Secondary</Heading>
  <Heading color="blue">Blue</Heading>
  <Heading color="indigo">Indigo</Heading>
</Box>
```

# ScrollBox.docs.mdx

description: Element with scrollable content

```tsx
import { ScrollBox } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
```

```tsx expand=true live=true
<ScrollBox style={{ height: '100px' }}>
  <Typography>
    Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Pellentesque cursus
    posuere lacinia. Proin mollis nisl a lacus mollis, a volutpat tortor
    consectetur. Vivamus mattis augue eu nulla molestie, a euismod nunc
    placerat. Fusce vitae elit sed dolor auctor faucibus luctus condimentum
    risus. Aenean pharetra mauris sodales ligula sodales, a tristique magna
    rhoncus. Fusce sit amet arcu suscipit, molestie dolor nec, blandit ipsum.
    Sed sodales blandit elit eget ultrices. Aliquam non blandit lacus. Etiam
    eget tellus vitae risus vestibulum pulvinar at a nibh. Orci varius natoque
    penatibus et magnis dis parturient montes, nascetur ridiculus mus. Aliquam
    volutpat elit odio. Fusce placerat nibh nec ante aliquam, id dictum turpis
    tempor. Sed maximus quam ut ipsum blandit, vel lobortis neque venenatis.
    Maecenas dignissim massa nec risus vestibulum bibendum. Duis malesuada, est
    dapibus porttitor aliquet, massa arcu fermentum nunc, nec feugiat erat magna
    viverra orci. Suspendisse eu ultrices mauris. Aliquam scelerisque mollis
    orci id volutpat. Nunc ac vestibulum odio, vitae feugiat ligula. Nunc
    lacinia nisi in gravida volutpat. Vivamus dui ex, ornare ut ante vel,
    dapibus tempor est. Proin congue sapien non dolor hendrerit, in dignissim
    risus scelerisque. Pellentesque quis egestas ex. Suspendisse quis diam nec
    dui sagittis sollicitudin. In hac habitasse platea dictumst. Vestibulum
    vestibulum dignissim tincidunt. Donec congue nibh lectus, nec facilisis
    tortor tempus sit amet. Phasellus varius mattis metus porta posuere. Integer
    posuere dapibus libero. Maecenas euismod sem sed blandit consectetur.
  </Typography>
</ScrollBox>
```

# Skeleton.docs.mdx

Source: https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/blob/main/docs/src/reference/mdx/atoms/Skeleton.docs.mdx

title: Skeleton
description: Loading placeholder

```tsx
import { Skeleton } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
```

```tsx expand=true live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Skeleton loading={getState('skeleton')}>Hello World</Skeleton>
  <VisuallyHidden>{setDefaultState('skeleton', true)}</VisuallyHidden>
  <Button onClick={() => toggleState('skeleton')}>Toggle</Button>
</Box>
```

## Props

## Wrap content

The container will automatically resize to encompass wrapped content.

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Skeleton loading={getState('skeleton')}>
    <Typography>
      Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod
      tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua. Ut enim ad minim
      veniam, quis nostrud exercitation ullamco laboris nisi ut aliquip ex ea
      commodo consequat. Duis aute irure dolor in reprehenderit in voluptate
      velit esse cillum dolore eu fugiat nulla pariatur. Excepteur sint occaecat
      cupidatat non proident, sunt in culpa qui officia deserunt mollit anim id
      est laborum.
    </Typography>
  </Skeleton>
  <VisuallyHidden>{setDefaultState('skeleton', true)}</VisuallyHidden>
  <Button size="small" onClick={() => toggleState('skeleton')}>
    Toggle Skeletons
  </Button>
</Box>
```

## Skeleton Group

Nest inside [`SkeletonGroup`](/components/SkeletonGroup) to manage multiple skeletons with a single `loading` prop.

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <SkeletonGroup loading={getState('skeleton')}>
    <Skeleton>
      <Heading level="1">Foo Bar Baz</Heading>
    </Skeleton>
    <Skeleton>
      <Typography>The quick brown fox jumped over the lazy dogs.</Typography>
    </Skeleton>
  </SkeletonGroup>
  <VisuallyHidden>{setDefaultState('skeleton', true)}</VisuallyHidden>
  <Button size="small" onClick={() => toggleState('skeleton')}>
    Toggle Skeletons
  </Button>
</Box>
```

---

# CheckboxRow.docs.mdx

Source: https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/blob/main/docs/src/reference/mdx/molecules/CheckboxRow.docs.mdx

title: CheckboxRow
description: An alternative checkbox component

```tsx
import { CheckboxRow } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
```

```tsx live=true expand=true
<CheckboxRow label="Label" subLabel="Sublabel" />
```

## Props

## States

```tsx live=true expand=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <CheckboxRow checked label="Checked" />
  <CheckboxRow label="Unchecked" />
  <CheckboxRow checked disabled label="Checked & Disabled" />
  <CheckboxRow disabled label="Unchecked & Disabled" />
</Box>
```

## Color Style

### Primary Colors

```tsx live=true expand=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <CheckboxRow colorStyle="blue" label="Blue" />
  <CheckboxRow colorStyle="indigo" label="Indigo" />
  <CheckboxRow colorStyle="purple" label="Purple" />
  <CheckboxRow colorStyle="pink" label="Pink" />
  <CheckboxRow colorStyle="red" label="Red" />
  <CheckboxRow colorStyle="orange" label="Orange" />
  <CheckboxRow colorStyle="yellow" label="Yellow" />
  <CheckboxRow colorStyle="green" label="Green" />
  <CheckboxRow colorStyle="grey" label="Grey" />
</Box>
```

### Secondary Colors

```tsx live=true expand=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <CheckboxRow colorStyle="blueSecondary" label="Blue" />
  <CheckboxRow colorStyle="indigoSecondary" label="Indigo" />
  <CheckboxRow colorStyle="purpleSecondary" label="Purple" />
  <CheckboxRow colorStyle="pinkSecondary" label="Pink" />
  <CheckboxRow colorStyle="redSecondary" label="Red" />
  <CheckboxRow colorStyle="orangeSecondary" label="Orange" />
  <CheckboxRow colorStyle="yellowSecondary" label="Yellow" />
  <CheckboxRow colorStyle="greenSecondary" label="Green" />
  <CheckboxRow colorStyle="greySecondary" label="Grey" />
</Box>
```

# CountdownCircle.docs.mdx

Source: https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/blob/main/docs/src/reference/mdx/molecules/CountdownCircle.docs.mdx

title: CountdownCircle
description: Element for counting down time

```tsx
import { CountdownCircle } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
```

```tsx expand=true live=true
<CountdownCircle countdownSeconds={30} />
```

## Props

## Colors

```tsx expand=true live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="row" gap="4">
  <CountdownCircle color="blue" countdownSeconds={30} />
  <CountdownCircle color="green" countdownSeconds={30} />
  <CountdownCircle color="indigo" countdownSeconds={30} />
</Box>
```

## Sizes

```tsx expand=true live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="row" gap="4">
  <CountdownCircle countdownSeconds={30} size="small" />
  <CountdownCircle countdownSeconds={30} size="large" />
</Box>
```

## Disabled

```tsx expand=true live=true
<CountdownCircle countdownSeconds={30} disabled />
```

# Dropdown.docs.mdx

Source: https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/blob/main/docs/src/reference/mdx/molecules/Dropdown.docs.mdx

title: Dropdown
description: Attaches a button menu to an element

```tsx
import { Dropdown } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
```

```tsx live=true  expand=ture minHeight=300px
<Dropdown
  align="left"
  items={[
    {
      label: 'Dashboard',
      onClick: () => null,
      color: 'text',
      icon: DotGridSVG,
    },
    {
      label: 'Disconnect',
      onClick: () => null,
      color: 'red',
      icon: ExitSVG,
    },
  ]}
  label="Account"
/>
```

## Props

## Dropdown Item Props

<PropsTable
  types={{
    label: {
      name: 'label',
      description: 'The text label.',
      type: {
        raw: 'string',
      },
    },
    color: {
      name: 'color',
      description: 'The color of the label.',
      type: {
        raw: '"blue" | "green" | "indigo" | "orange" | "pink" | "purple" | "red" | "teal" | "yellow" | "grey" | "accent" | "accentSecondary" | "accentSecondaryHover" | "accentTertiary" | "accentText" | "accentGradient" | "background" | "backgroundHide" | "backgroundSecondary" | "backgroundTertiary" | "border" | "borderSecondary" | "borderTertiary" | "foreground" | "foregroundSecondary" | "foregroundSecondaryHover" | "foregroundTertiary" | "groupBackground" | "groupBorder" | "gradients" | "text" | "textPlaceholder" | "textSecondary" | "textTertiary"',
      },
    },
    disabled: {
      name: 'disabled',
      description: 'The disabled attribute of button element.',
      type: {
        raw: 'boolean',
      },
    },
    onClick: {
      name: 'onClick',
      description: 'An event handler for click events.',
      type: {
        raw: '() => void',
      },
    },
    showIndicator: {
      name: 'showIndicator',
      description: 'A dot indicator.',
      type: {
        raw: 'boolean | Colors',
      },
    },
    icon: {
      name: 'icon',
      description: 'An icon that leads the label.',
      type: {
        raw: 'ReactNode'
      }
    },
    href: {
      name: 'href',
      description: 'A link that opens on click.',
      type: {
        raw: 'string'
      }
    }
  }}
/>

## Direction

```tsx live=true expand=true minHeight=300px
<>
  <div style={{ height: '300px' }} />
  <Dropdown
    direction="up"
    items={[
      { label: 'Dashboard', onClick: () => null, color: 'text' },
      { label: 'Disconnect', onClick: () => null, color: 'red' },
    ]}
    label="Account"
  />
</>
```

## Align

```tsx live=true expand=true minHeight=300px
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="row" justifyContent="space-between" gap="4">
  <Dropdown
    align="left"
    items={[
      { label: 'Text Label 1', onClick: () => null },
      { label: 'Text Label 2', onClick: () => null },
      { label: 'Text Label 3', onClick: () => null },
      { label: 'Text Label 4', onClick: () => null },
    ]}
    label="Left"
  />
  <Dropdown
    align="right"
    items={[
      { label: 'Text Label 1', onClick: () => null },
      { label: 'Text Label 2', onClick: () => null },
      { label: 'Text Label 3', onClick: () => null },
      { label: 'Text Label 4', onClick: () => null },
    ]}
    label="Right"
  />
</Box>
```

## Short Throw

```tsx live=true expand=true minHeight=300px
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="row" justifyContent="space-between" gap="4">
  <Dropdown
    align="left"
    items={[
      { label: 'Text Label 1', onClick: () => null },
      { label: 'Text Label 2', onClick: () => null },
      { label: 'Text Label 3', onClick: () => null },
      { label: 'Text Label 4', onClick: () => null },
    ]}
    label="Regular Throw"
  />
  <Dropdown
    align="right"
    items={[
      { label: 'Text Label 1', onClick: () => null },
      { label: 'Text Label 2', onClick: () => null },
      { label: 'Text Label 3', onClick: () => null },
      { label: 'Text Label 4', onClick: () => null },
    ]}
    label="Short Throw"
    shortThrow
  />
</Box>
```

## Scrollable

```tsx live=true expand=true minHeight=300px
<Dropdown
  height={52}
  items={[
    { label: 'Text Label 1', onClick: () => null },
    { label: 'Text Label 2', onClick: () => null },
    { label: 'Text Label 3', onClick: () => null },
    { label: 'Text Label 4', onClick: () => null },
    { label: 'Text Label 5', onClick: () => null },
    { label: 'Text Label 6', onClick: () => null },
    { label: 'Text Label 7', onClick: () => null },
    { label: 'Text Label 8', onClick: () => null },
  ]}
  label="Scrollable"
/>
```

## Item with Indicator

```tsx live=true  expand=ture minHeight=300px
<Dropdown
  align="left"
  items={[
    {
      label: 'None',
      onClick: () => null,
      color: 'text',
      icon: DotGridSVG,
    },
    {
      label: 'Default',
      onClick: () => null,
      color: 'text',
      icon: CogSVG,
      showIndicator: true,
    },
    {
      label: 'Custom',
      onClick: () => null,
      color: 'red',
      icon: ExitSVG,
      showIndicator: 'red',
    },
  ]}
  label="Account"
  width={52}
/>
```

## Custom Indicator Colour

```tsx live=true  expand=ture minHeight=300px
<Dropdown
  align="left"
  indicatorColor="red"
  items={[
    {
      label: 'None',
      onClick: () => null,
      color: 'text',
      icon: DotGridSVG,
    },
    {
      label: 'Default',
      onClick: () => null,
      color: 'text',
      icon: CogSVG,
      showIndicator: true,
    },
    {
      label: 'Custom',
      onClick: () => null,
      color: 'red',
      icon: ExitSVG,
      showIndicator: 'red',
    },
  ]}
  label="Account"
  width={52}
/>
```

## Custom button

```tsx live=true expand=true minHeight=300px
<Dropdown
  items={[
    { label: 'English', onClick: () => null, color: 'text' },
    { label: '简体中文', onClick: () => null, color: 'text' },
    { label: 'Français', onClick: () => null, color: 'text' },
    { label: 'Español', onClick: () => null, color: 'text' },
  ]}
  label="Language"
>
  <button>Custom button</button>
</Dropdown>
```

## Custom menu button

```tsx live=true expand=true minHeight=300px
<Dropdown
  items={[
    <Button
      key="item1"
      prefix={PlusSVG}
      shadowless
      size="small"
      tone="accent"
    >
      Item1
    </Button>,
    <Button key="item2" prefix={PlusSVG} shadowless size="small" tone="red">
      Item2
    </Button>,
  ]}
  label="Custom"
/>
```

## Items with icons

```tsx live=true minHeight=300px
<Dropdown
  items={[
    {
      label: 'None',
      onClick: () => null,
      color: 'text',
      icon: DotGridSVG,
    },
    {
      label: 'Default',
      onClick: () => null,
      color: 'text',
      icon: CogSVG,
    },
  ]}
  label="Custom"
/>
```

## Items as link

```tsx live=true minHeight=300px
<Dropdown 
  items={[
    {
      label: 'I am a link',
      href: 'https://ens.domains',
      color: 'text'
    },
    {
      label: 'I am not a link',
      color: 'text'
    }
  ]}
  label="Links"
/>
```

# FieldSet.docs.mdx

Source: https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/blob/main/docs/src/reference/mdx/molecules/FieldSet.docs.mdx

title: FieldSet
description: Group related form elements

```tsx
import { FieldSet, Input } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
```

```tsx live=true expand=true
<FieldSet legend="Token">
  <Input label="Name" placeholder="Ethereum Name Service" />
  <Input
    label="Symbol"
    placeholder="ENS"
    prefix="$"
    textTransform="uppercase"
  />
</FieldSet>
```

## Props

## Description

```tsx live=true
<FieldSet description="Basic information about your token." legend="Token">
  <Input label="Name" placeholder="Ethereum Name Service" />
  <Input
    label="Symbol"
    placeholder="ENS"
    prefix="$"
    textTransform="uppercase"
  />
</FieldSet>
```

## Status

```tsx live=true
<FieldSet legend="Token" status="required">
  <Input label="Name" placeholder="Ethereum Name Service" />
  <Input
    label="Symbol"
    placeholder="ENS"
    prefix="$"
    textTransform="uppercase"
  />
</FieldSet>
```

## Disabled

Uses native [`fieldset[disabled]`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/fieldset#attr-disabled) to automatically disable form elements inside.

```tsx live=true
<FieldSet disabled legend="Token">
  <Input label="Name" placeholder="Ethereum Name Service" />
  <Input
    label="Symbol"
    placeholder="ENS"
    prefix="$"
    textTransform="uppercase"
  />
</FieldSet>
```

# Input.docs.mdx

Source: https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/blob/main/docs/src/reference/mdx/molecules/Input.docs.mdx

title: Input
description: Surface for accepting user input

```tsx
import { Input, SearchSVG } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
```

```tsx live=true expand=true
<Input
  icon={<MagnifyingGlassSimpleSVG />}
  label="Wallet Address"
  placeholder="0xA0Cf…251e"
  prefix="hello"
  suffix="world"
/>
```

## Props

## Description

```tsx live=true
<Input
  description="The Ethereum address where raised funds will be sent from the crowdfund."
  label="Wallet Address"
  placeholder="0xA0Cf…251e"
/>
```

## Error

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Input
    description="Default input"
    error="Error message"
    label="Default"
    placeholder="Placeholder"
    value="Invalid input"
  />
  <Input
    description="Input with icon"
    error="Error message"
    icon={<MagnifyingGlassSimpleSVG />}
    label="Icon"
    placeholder="Placeholder"
    showDot
    value="Invalid input"
  />
  <Input
    description="Input with prefix"
    error="Error message"
    icon={<MagnifyingGlassSimpleSVG />}
    label="Prefix"
    placeholder="Placeholder"
    prefix={
      <>
        <MagnifyingGlassSVG />
        Prefix
      </>
    }
    showDot
    value="Invalid input"
  />
  <Input
    description="Input with suffix"
    error="Error message"
    icon={<MagnifyingGlassSimpleSVG />}
    label="Suffix"
    placeholder="Placeholder"
    showDot
    suffix={
      <>
        Suffix
        <EyeSVG />
      </>
    }
    value="Invalid input"
  />
  <Input
    description="Input with prefix and suffix"
    error="Error message"
    icon={<MagnifyingGlassSimpleSVG />}
    label="Multiple"
    placeholder="Placeholder"
    prefix={
      <>
        <MagnifyingGlassSVG />
        Prefix
      </>
    }
    showDot
    suffix={
      <>
        Suffix
        <EyeSVG />
      </>
    }
    value="Invalid input"
  />
</Box>
```

## Affixes

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Input
    description="Prefix using a svg component."
    icon={<MagnifyingGlassSimpleSVG />}
    label="Search"
    placeholder="Name or wallet address"
    prefix={
      <>
        <MagnifyingGlassSVG />
        Prefix
      </>
    }
    suffix={
      <>
        Suffix
        <EyeSVG />
      </>
    }
  />
</Box>
```

## Show Dot

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Input
    icon={<MagnifyingGlassSimpleSVG />}
    label="Placeholder"
    placeholder="Enter text here..."
    prefix={
      <>
        <MagnifyingGlassSVG />
        Prefix
      </>
    }
    showDot
    suffix={
      <>
        Suffix
        <EyeSVG />
      </>
    }
  />
  <Input
    icon={<MagnifyingGlassSimpleSVG />}
    label="Validated"
    placeholder="Enter text here..."
    prefix={
      <>
        <MagnifyingGlassSVG />
        Prefix
      </>
    }
    showDot
    suffix={
      <>
        Suffix
        <EyeSVG />
      </>
    }
    validated
  />
  <Input
    error="Error messsage"
    icon={<MagnifyingGlassSimpleSVG />}
    label="Error"
    placeholder="Enter text here..."
    prefix={
      <>
        <MagnifyingGlassSVG />
        Prefix
      </>
    }
    showDot
    suffix={
      <>
        Suffix
        <EyeSVG />
      </>
    }
  />
</Box>
```

## Disabled

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Input
    description="Prefix using a svg component."
    disabled
    icon={<MagnifyingGlassSimpleSVG />}
    label="Search"
    placeholder="Name or wallet address"
    prefix={
      <>
        <MagnifyingGlassSVG />
        Prefix
      </>
    }
    suffix={
      <>
        Suffix
        <EyeSVG />
      </>
    }
  />
</Box>
```

## Clearable

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Input
    clearable
    label="Clearable input"
    placeholder="Foo bar baz"
    type="text"
  />
  <Input
    clearable={false}
    label="Not clearable input"
    placeholder="Foo bar baz"
  />
</Box>
```

## Sizes

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Input label="Small" placeholder="Placeholder" size="small" />
  <Input label="Medium" placeholder="Placeholder" size="medium" />
  <Input label="Large" placeholder="Placeholder" size="large" />
  <Input label="Extra Large" placeholder="Placeholder" size="extraLarge" />
</Box>
```

## Hide Label

```tsx live=true
<Input hideLabel label="Wallet Address" placeholder="Wallet Address" />
```

## onClickAction

```tsx live=true
<Input
  actionIcon={getState('show-password') ? <EyeSVG /> : <EyeStrikethroughSVG />}
  type={getState('show-password') ? 'text' : 'password'}
  value="password"
  onClickAction={() => toggleState('show-password')}
/>
```

## alwaysShowAction

```tsx live=true
<Input alwaysShowAction clearable />
```

## Read Only

```tsx live=true
<Input readOnly value="Read only input" />
```

## Icon Width

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Input
    icon={<div style={{ width: '32px', height: '32px', background: 'red' }} />}
    iconWidth="8"
    label="Custom icon width"
  />
  <Input icon={<FlameSVG />} iconWidth="8" label="Custom icon width" />
</Box>
```

# Modal.docs.mdx

title: Modal
description: Modal for displaying content in a seperated window

```tsx
import { Modal } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
```

```tsx live=true
<>
  <Button onClick={() => toggleState('modal')}>Open Modal</Button>
  <Modal open={getState('modal')} onDismiss={() => toggleState('modal')}>
    <Card style={{ width: '100%' }}>
      <Typography>This is a modal popup.</Typography>
    </Card>
  </Modal>
</>
```

# PageButtons.docs.mdx

Source: https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/blob/main/docs/src/reference/mdx/molecules/PageButtons.docs.mdx

title: PageButtons
description: Page button component

```tsx
import { PageButtons } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
```

```tsx live=true
<div
  style={{
    padding: '16px',
    borderRadius: '12px',
  }}
>
  <PageButtons
    alwaysShowFirst
    alwaysShowLast
    current={getState('pageButtons') || 1}
    total={100}
    onChange={(value) => setState('pageButtons', value)}
  />
</div>
```

## Props

## Size

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <Field label="Small">
    <PageButtons
      alwaysShowFirst
      alwaysShowLast
      current={getState('pageButtons') || 1}
      size="small"
      total={100}
      onChange={(value) => setState('pageButtons', value)}
    />
  </Field>
  <Field label="Medium">
    <PageButtons
      alwaysShowFirst
      alwaysShowLast
      current={getState('pageButtons') || 1}
      size="medium"
      total={100}
      onChange={(value) => setState('pageButtons', value)}
    />
  </Field>
</Box>
```

```tsx expand=true live=true
    address="0xb6e040c9ecaae172a89bd561c5f73e1c48d28cd9"
    ensName="frontend.ens.eth"
  />

```

## Props

## With Dropdown

```tsx live=true minHeight=300px
<Card style={{ backgroundColor: 'grey' }}>
  <Profile
    address="0xb6e040c9ecaae172a89bd561c5f73e1c48d28cd9"
    avatar="https://i.imgur.com/BSJBpQE.jpg"
    dropdownItems={[
      { label: 'Dashboard', onClick: () => null, icon: DotGridSVG },
      {
        label: 'Disconnect',
        onClick: () => null,
        color: 'red',
        icon: ExitSVG,
      },
    ]}
    ensName="frontend.ens.eth"
  />
```

# RadioButtonGroup.docs.mdx

Source: https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/blob/main/docs/src/reference/mdx/molecules/RadioButtonGroup.docs.mdx

title: RadioButtonGroup
description: Allows for automatic state management of radio buttons.

```tsx
import { RadioButtonGroup } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
```

```tsx live=true
<Card shadow>
  <FieldSet
    legend={`Radio Buttons - Current Value: ${
      getState('radiobuttongroup') || '30'
    }`}
  >
    <RadioButtonGroup
      value={getState('radiobuttongroup') || '30'}
      onChange={(e) => setState('radiobuttongroup', e.target.value)}
    >
      <RadioButton label="Label 10" name="RadioButtonGroup" value="10" />
      <RadioButton label="Label 20" name="RadioButtonGroup" value="20" />
      <RadioButton label="Label 30" name="RadioButtonGroup" value="30" />
    </RadioButtonGroup>
  </FieldSet>
</Card>
```

## Props

## Inline

```tsx live=true
<Card shadow>
  <FieldSet
    legend={`Radio Buttons - Current Value: ${
      getState('radiobuttongroup') || '30'
    }`}
  >
    <RadioButtonGroup
      inline
      value={getState('radiobuttongroup') || '30'}
      onChange={(e) => setState('radiobuttongroup', e.target.value)}
    >
      <RadioButton
        label="Label 10"
        name="RadioButtonGroup"
        value="10"
        width="max"
      />
      <RadioButton
        label="Label 20"
        name="RadioButtonGroup"
        value="20"
        width="max"
      />
      <RadioButton
        label="Label 30"
        name="RadioButtonGroup"
        value="30"
        width="max"
      />
    </RadioButtonGroup>
  </FieldSet>
</Card>
```

## Props

## Option Props

<PropsTable
  types={{
    value: {
      name: 'value',
      description: 'The value of the option.',
      required: true,
      type: {
        raw: 'string',
      },
    },
    label: {
      name: 'label',
      description: 'The human readable text for the option.',
      type: {
        raw: 'string',
      },
    },
    node: {
      name: 'node',
      description:
        'A react node that acts as the label as an alternative to the label prop.',
      type: {
        raw: 'ReactNode',
      },
    },
    prefix: {
      name: 'prefix',
      description: 'The text or component inserted before the label.',
      type: {
        raw: 'ReactNode',
      },
    },
    disabled: {
      name: 'disabled',
      description: 'If true, prevents user interaction with option.',
      type: {
        raw: 'boolean',
      },

# SkeletonGroup.docs.mdx

Source: https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/blob/main/docs/src/reference/mdx/molecules/SkeletonGroup.docs.mdx

title: SkeletonGroup
description: Manages loading state for multiple skeletons

```tsx
import { SkeletonGroup } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
```

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <SkeletonGroup loading={getState('loading')}>
    <Skeleton>
      <Heading level="1">Foo Bar Baz</Heading>
    </Skeleton>
    <Skeleton>
      <Typography>The quick brown fox jumped over the lazy dogs.</Typography>
    </Skeleton>
  </SkeletonGroup>
  <VisuallyHidden>{setDefaultState('loading', true)}</VisuallyHidden>
  <Button size="small" onClick={() => toggleState('loading')}>
    Toggle Skeleton Group
  </Button>
</Box>
```

## Props

# Tooltip.docs.mdx

Source: https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/blob/main/docs/src/reference/mdx/molecules/Tooltip.docs.mdx

title: Tooltip
description: Attaches a popover to a target component. Built with DynamicPopover.

```tsx
import { Tooltip, TooltipProps } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
```

```tsx live=true  expand=ture minHeight=300px
<div
  style={{
    width: '100%',
    display: 'flex',
    flexDirection: 'column',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: 20,
  }}
>
  <Tooltip
    additionalGap={0}
    content={<div>Content</div>}
    mobilePlacement="top"
    mobileWidth={250}
    placement="top"
    targetId="buttonIdTop"
    width={250}
  >
    <Button
      id="buttonIdTop"
      psuedoDisabled
      shadowless
      shouldShowTooltipIndicator
      style={{ width: 250 }}
    >
      Top
    </Button>
  </Tooltip>
  <Tooltip
    content={<div>Content</div>}
    mobilePlacement="left"
    mobileWidth={50}
    placement="left"
    targetId="buttonIdLeft"
    width={100}
  >
    <Button
      id="buttonIdLeft"
      psuedoDisabled
      shadowless
      shouldShowTooltipIndicator
      style={{ width: 250 }}
    >
      Left
    </Button>
  </Tooltip>
  <Tooltip
    additionalGap={0}
    content={<div>Content</div>}
    mobilePlacement="bottom"
    mobileWidth={250}
    open
    placement="bottom"
    targetId="buttonIdBottom"
    width={250}
  >
    <Button
      id="buttonIdBottom"
      psuedoDisabled
      shadowless
      shouldShowTooltipIndicator
      style={{ width: 250 }}
    >
      Bottom
    </Button>
  </Tooltip>
  <Tooltip
    content={<div>Content</div>}
    mobilePlacement="right"
    mobileWidth={50}
    open
    placement="right"
    targetId="buttonIdRight"
    width={100}
  >
    <Button
      id="buttonIdRight"
      psuedoDisabled
      shadowless
      shouldShowTooltipIndicator
      style={{ width: 250 }}
    >
      Right
    </Button>
  </Tooltip>
</div>
```

# Dialog.docs.mdx

Source: https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/blob/main/docs/src/reference/mdx/organisms/Dialog.docs.mdx

title: Dialog
description: Dialog box for displaying information to the user

```tsx
import { Dialog } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
```

```tsx live=true
<>
  <Button onClick={() => toggleState('dialog')}>Open Dialog</Button>
  <Dialog
    currentStep={1}
    open={getState('dialog')}
    subtitle="Dialog Subtitle"
    title="Dialog Title"
    onDismiss={() => toggleState('dialog')}
  >
    <Dialog.Content>
      <Typography>Dialog text content.</Typography>
    </Dialog.Content>
    <Dialog.Footer
      leading={<Button colorStyle="accentSecondary">Leading</Button>}
      trailing={<Button>Trailing</Button>}
    />
  </Dialog>
</>
```

## Props

## Variants

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="row" flexWrap="wrap" gap="4">
  <>
    <Button onClick={() => toggleState('dialog-closable')}>
      Open Closable Dialog
    </Button>
    <Dialog
      open={getState('dialog-closable')}
      subtitle="This is a closable dialog."
      title="Closable Dialog"
      variant="closable"
      onDismiss={() => toggleState('dialog-closable')}
    >
      <Typography>Dialog text content.</Typography>
    </Dialog>
  </>
  <>
    <Button onClick={() => toggleState('dialog-actionable')}>
      Open Actionable Dialog
    </Button>
    <Dialog
      leading={<Button colorStyle="accentSecondary">Leading</Button>}
      open={getState('dialog-actionable')}
      stepCount={3}
      subtitle="This is an actionable dialog."
      title="Actionable Dialog"
      trailing={<Button>Trailing</Button>}
      variant="actionable"
      onDismiss={() => toggleState('dialog-actionable')}
    >
      <Typography>Dialog text content.</Typography>
    </Dialog>
  </>
  <>
    <Button onClick={() => toggleState('dialog-blank')}>
      Open Blank Dialog
    </Button>
    <Dialog
      open={getState('dialog-blank')}
      variant="blank"
      onDismiss={() => toggleState('dialog-blank')}
    >
      <Typography>This is a blank dialog.</Typography>
    </Dialog>
  </>
</Box>
```

## Steps

```tsx live=true
<Box display="flex" flexDirection="row" flexWrap="wrap" gap="4">
  <>
    <Button onClick={() => toggleState('dialog-steps-0')}>Not Started</Button>
    <Dialog
      currentStep={0}
      leading={<Button colorStyle="accentSecondary">Leading</Button>}
      open={getState('dialog-steps-0')}
      stepCount={3}
      subtitle="This dialog has 0/3 steps complete."
      title="Start"
      trailing={<Button>Trailing</Button>}
      variant="actionable"
      onDismiss={() => toggleState('dialog-steps-0')}
    >
      <Typography>Dialog text content.</Typography>
    </Dialog>
  </>
  <>
    <Button onClick={() => toggleState('dialog-steps-1')}>
      Step 1 In Progress
    </Button>
    <Dialog
      currentStep={1}
      leading={<Button colorStyle="accentSecondary">Leading</Button>}
      open={getState('dialog-steps-1')}
      stepCount={3}
      subtitle="This dialog has step 1 in progress."
      title="Start"
      trailing={<Button>Trailing</Button>}
      variant="actionable"
      onDismiss={() => toggleState('dialog-steps-1')}
    >
      <Typography>Dialog text content.</Typography>
    </Dialog>
  </>
  <>
    <Button onClick={() => toggleState('dialog-steps-2')}>
      All Steps Complete
    </Button>
    <Dialog
      currentStep={4}
      leading={<Button colorStyle="accentSecondary">Leading</Button>}
      open={getState('dialog-steps-2')}
      stepCount={3}
      subtitle="This dialog has all steps."
      title="Start"
      trailing={<Button>Trailing</Button>}
      variant="actionable"
      onDismiss={() => toggleState('dialog-steps-2')}
    >
      <Typography>Dialog text content.</Typography>
    </Dialog>
  </>
  <>
    <Button onClick={() => toggleState('dialog-steps-3')}>
      Custom Step Status
    </Button>
    <Dialog
      currentStep={2}
      leading={<Button colorStyle="accentSecondary">Leading</Button>}
      open={getState('dialog-steps-3')}
      stepCount={3}
      stepStatus="notStarted"
      subtitle="This dialog has step 3 not started."
      title="Start"
      trailing={<Button>Trailing</Button>}
      variant="actionable"
      onDismiss={() => toggleState('dialog-steps-3')}
    >
      <Typography>Dialog text content.</Typography>
    </Dialog>
  </>
</Box>
```

## Dialog Components

```tsx live=true
<>
  <Button onClick={() => toggleState('dialog-components')}>
    Dialog Components
  </Button>
  <Dialog
    open={getState('dialog-components')}
    variant="blank"
    onDismiss={() => toggleState('dialog-components')}
  >
    <Dialog.Heading title="Heading" />
    <Dialog.Content>
      <Input showDot validated/>
      <div> Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Pellentesque cursus
    posuere lacinia. Proin mollis nisl a lacus mollis, a volutpat tortor
    consectetur. Vivamus mattis augue eu nulla molestie, a euismod nunc

    Sed sodales blandit elit eget ultrices. Aliquam non blandit lacus. Etiam
    eget tellus vitae risus vestibulum pulvinar at a nibh. Orci varius natoque
    penatibus et magnis dis parturient montes, nascetur ridiculus mus. Aliquam
    volutpat elit odio. Fusce placerat nibh nec ante aliquam, id dictum turpis
    tempor. Sed maximus quam ut ipsum blandit, vel lobortis neque venenatis.
    Maecenas dignissim massa nec risus vestibulum bibendum. Duis malesuada, est
    dapibus porttitor aliquet, massa arcu fermentum nunc, nec feugiat erat magna
    viverra orci. Suspendisse eu ultrices mauris. Aliquam scelerisque mollis
    orci id volutpat. Nunc ac vestibulum odio, vitae feugiat ligula. Nunc
    lacinia nisi in gravida volutpat. Vivamus dui ex, ornare ut ante vel,
    dapibus tempor est. Proin congue sapien non dolor hendrerit, in dignissim
    risus scelerisque. Pellentesque quis egestas ex. Suspendisse quis diam nec

      trailing={<Button>Trailing</Button>}
    />
  </Dialog.Content>
</>

```

### Dialog.Content 

The Dialog.Content component is a ScrollBox component that is used to contain the content of the Dialog. It is also responsible for setting the responsive sizing of the dialog. It can be used to display a form element by setting the <b>as</b> prop to "form". The <b>fullWidth</b> prop can be used to make the content area the width of the dialog.

#### Props

This component inherits the props of [ScrollBox](/components/atoms/ScrollBox/). The additional unique props are listed below.

<PropsTable sourceLink={'https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/tree/main/components/src/components/organisms/Dialog/DialogContent.tsx'} types={{
  as: {
    name: 'as',
    description: 'Option to render the component as a form element',
    defaultValue: { value: 'undefined' },
    required: false,
    type: {
      name: 'form | undefined',
      value: [{value: 'form'}, {value: 'undefined'}]
    }
  },
  fullWidth: {
    name: 'fullWidth',
    description: 'If true, the width of the content container will be the width of the dialog',
    defaultValue: { value: 'undefined' },
    required: false,
    type: {
      name: 'boolean | undefined',
      value: [{value: 'true'}, {value: 'false'}, {value: 'undefined'}],
    },
  }
}} />

#### as

```tsx live=true
<>
  <Button onClick={() => toggleState('dialog-components')}>
    Dialog Components
  </Button>
  <Dialog
    open={getState('dialog-components')}
    variant="blank"
    onDismiss={() => toggleState('dialog-components')}
  >
    <Dialog.Heading title="Heading" />
    <Dialog.Content as="form" onSubmit={() => alert('submitted')}>
    <Typography>Click this button to simulate an submit</Typography>
    <Button type="submit">Submit</Button>
    </Dialog.Content>
    <Dialog.Footer
      leading={<Button colorStyle="accentSecondary">Leading</Button>}
      trailing={<Button>Trailing</Button>}
    />
  </Dialog.Content>
</>

```

#### fullWidth

If true, the width of the <b>scrollbox</b> will be the width of the dialog. By default the content area will have a horizontal padding of 8px to cover the overflow from inputs. To achieve true edge to edge content, set <b>horizontalPadding</b> to "0".

```tsx live=true
<>
  <Button onClick={() => toggleState('dialog-components')}>
    Dialog Components
  </Button>
  <Dialog
    open={getState('dialog-components')}
    variant="blank"
    onDismiss={() => toggleState('dialog-components')}
  >
    <Dialog.Heading title="Heading" />
    <Dialog.Content fullWidth horizontalPadding="0">
      <div> Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Pellentesque cursus
    posuere lacinia. Proin mollis nisl a lacus mollis, a volutpat tortor
    consectetur. Vivamus mattis augue eu nulla molestie, a euismod nunc
    placerat. Fusce vitae elit sed dolor auctor faucibus luctus condimentum
    risus. Aenean pharetra mauris sodales ligula sodales, a tristique magna
    rhoncus. Fusce sit amet arcu suscipit, molestie dolor nec, blandit ipsum.
    Sed sodales blandit elit eget ultrices. Aliquam non blandit lacus. Etiam
    eget tellus vitae risus vestibulum pulvinar at a nibh. Orci varius natoque
    penatibus et magnis dis parturient montes, nascetur ridiculus mus. Aliquam
    volutpat elit odio. Fusce placerat nibh nec ante aliquam, id dictum turpis
    tempor. Sed maximus quam ut ipsum blandit, vel lobortis neque venenatis.
    Maecenas dignissim massa nec risus vestibulum bibendum. Duis malesuada, est
    dapibus porttitor aliquet, massa arcu fermentum nunc, nec feugiat erat magna
    viverra orci. Suspendisse eu ultrices mauris. Aliquam scelerisque mollis
    orci id volutpat. Nunc ac vestibulum odio, vitae feugiat ligula. Nunc
    lacinia nisi in gravida volutpat. Vivamus dui ex, ornare ut ante vel,
    dapibus tempor est. Proin congue sapien non dolor hendrerit, in dignissim
    risus scelerisque. Pellentesque quis egestas ex. Suspendisse quis diam nec
    dui sagittis sollicitudin. In hac habitasse platea dictumst. Vestibulum
    vestibulum dignissim tincidunt. Donec congue nibh lectus, nec facilisis
    tortor tempus sit amet. Phasellus varius mattis metus porta posuere. Integer
    posuere dapibus libero. Maecenas euismod sem sed blandit consectetur.</div>
    </Dialog.Content>
    <Dialog.Footer
      leading={<Button colorStyle="accentSecondary">Leading</Button>}
      trailing={<Button>Trailing</Button>}
    />
  </Dialog.Content>
</>

```

# Toast.docs.mdx

Source: https://github.com/ensdomains/thorin/blob/main/docs/src/reference/mdx/organisms/Toast.docs.mdx

title: Toast
description: Provides brief notifcations to the user

```tsx
import { Toast } from '@ensdomains/thorin'
```

```tsx live=true expand=true
<>
  <Button onClick={() => toggleState('toast')}>Show Toast</Button>
  <Toast
    description="This is an example toast."
    open={getState('toast')}
    title="Example Toast"
    variant="desktop"
    onClose={() => setState('toast', false)}
  >
    <Button shadowless size="small">
      Click Me
    </Button>
  </Toast>
</>
```
